title: Severe allergic reaction auto-injector readiness
content: Anaphylaxis can progress fast. This entry supports use of the person’s prescribed auto-injector only as labeled and urgent escalation.
steps: Look for swelling of lips/tongue/throat, breathing trouble, widespread hives, faintness, vomiting, or rapid worsening after exposure.
Help the person use their own prescribed auto-injector according to its label or training.
Keep them lying or in a comfortable breathing position.
Record trigger, time, and medicine used.
